run_inference_attribute: run inference to compute text attribution using a loaded model checkpoint and forward function
run_inference_restore: run inference to restore masked text segments using beam search and model parameters
run_inference_contextualize: run inference to contextualize text using dataset retrieval and model predictions
load_model_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint pickle to extract params, config, alphabet, and forward function
run_inference_cli: run the inference CLI with input text or file, checkpoint path, and language flag
